scope: Line-scoped priced add-ons: explicit quantity, singular product references, and removing the add-on by line
baselineFindings: «ponle 2 quesos extra a las de A» answered «Por ahora no manejamos…» (the local glossary rewrites «ponle» to «agrégame», which the handler did not accept, and digits were rejected)
«las de A con 2 quesos extra» added ×2 without tying them to the line
«al bao de B ponle queso extra» answered «no manejamos»; «ponle queso extra a la bao de B» saved the whole sentence as a free note; «el bao B con queso extra» added ×1 with a junk note
«las de A sin queso extra» added a dish note and kept charging the add-on; «quítale el queso extra a las de A» answered «no manejamos»
fix: tryHandleLineScopedPaidAddon extended. References: held option, product token plus optional option («al bao de B», «la pizza Gruesa»), or todas. Explicit quantity before the add-on (digit or dos…cinco) is a total; «doble» or «por/para cada una» is per dish unit; reply says «en total» when it differs from the dish units. Removal by line («las de A sin Y», «quítale/sácale/ya no le pongas Y a/al …») removes only the add-on units whose «para …» note names that line (rows with several lines are reduced and their note rewritten); a line without that add-on is answered without changes. Glossary forms agrégame/échame/ponme are accepted. More than one number, unknown add-ons and add-ons with options keep their routes.
knownGaps: Two quantities in one message («2 a las de A y 3 a las de B») keep existing routes
Add-ons with configurable options are still not line-scoped
Splitting a combined «para A y B» note assumes product names without « y »
